Description

Product ID: 482297

  • Made of premium 100% SUPIMA® cotton for a fine, smooth texture.

    Elegant collar width and stitching complements the texture of the fabric.

  • This unisex T-shirt is designed as a refined everyday essential with a clean silhouette and balanced proportions. Made from 100% SUPIMA® cotton, it features a fine, smooth texture created by long fibers that contribute to a polished surface and consistent color appearance. Careful adjustments to the neckline, body width, and sleeve length result in a balanced shape that differs from oversized styles, making it suitable for wearing on its own in warm weather or layered under a shirt, jacket, or mid-weight fleece piece as temperatures change. Thoughtful collar width and precise stitching complement the fabric texture for a timeless look that works across casual and more styled outfits.

    - Made from 100% SUPIMA® cotton with long fibers that create a fine, smooth fabric surface.
    - The fabric offers a clean appearance and consistent coloring compared to standard cotton T-shirts.
    - Classic silhouette provides a balanced fit that differs from oversized styles.
    - Adjusted neckline, body width, and sleeve length support a clean, proportioned shape.
    - Sleek collar width and neat stitching enhance the overall structure and finish.
    - Suitable for warm weather wear or layered styling across seasons.
    - Unisex design follows men’s sizing, resulting in a straightforward fit across a range of body types.
    - Designed as a timeless wardrobe piece that pairs easily with denim, straight-leg pants, or tailored layers.

  • Production

    Production: Cambodia, Viet Nam

    Our brand is continuously working to improve our understanding of the production process in our supply chain and to verify this information both in-house and with third parties. By having full understanding of the origins of raw materials, and the locations of the spinning, material production, sewing, knitting, and assembly processes, we are improving quality of our clothing and at the same time aiming to thoroughly ensure safe and secure manufacturing. We will continue to post information for customers to access and learn more about their clothing.

If you live in California, under the CCPA you have the right to opt-out of the sale of your personal information.     Manage Consent Preferences

    Strictly Necessary Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

    Performance Cookies

    These cookies allow us to collect information about the traffic on our website and the technical performance of the website. They help us to get detailed and advanced analytics. This includes cookies from third-party analytics services.
